stem:
Jatin has two ribbons of lengths 18 cm and 24 cm. He wants to cut both into pieces of the same whole-number length, using the largest possible piece length with no ribbon left over.

What should he find?

options.text: Any common factor of 18 and 24, even if a larger one also fits.
The highest common factor of 18 and 24.

teacher.key_rationale: The largest equal piece length that divides both lengths is the HCF. A common multiple answers a different question. Any common factor may be too small. The sum is outside this hinge.
